projectionRetained.runs: every queued, preparing, starting, running or waiting run; the runs its window references; the run the shell presents; the todo-list owner; and, with a plan present, the latest started run. Older settled runs outside that set are absent.
projectionRetained.runtimeRequests: every pending or waiting request; requests on window-referenced nodes or provider turns. Resolved history outside that set is absent.
projectionRetained.plans: active plans plus the latest non-superseded todo_list; a window-referenced proposed_plan loses markdown and a todo_list loses explanation (detailInTurnItem true).
projectionRetained.providerThreads: active threads, window- or retained-node-referenced threads and the latest todo owner; older idle threads with internal pending tasks may be omitted.
projectionRetained.contextHandoffs: pending or ready handoffs; a window-referenced one loses summaryText (detailInTurnItem true).

subscribeThread.retainedOutsideWindow: run_interrupt_request items, and user_input_request or approval_request items whose request is still pending
